subtitles.estimatedTiming: Telegram’s transcription has no timings — the lines are placed approximately
subtitles.menu.enabledInfo: Recognizes speech and shows it as lines over the video
subtitles.menu.footer: A “Show Subtitles” item in the “…” menu of videos. Speech is recognized on the device when the language model is there, otherwise by Apple’s server; with Telegram Premium, Telegram transcribes round videos. Nothing is sent to any chat. Translation uses the service chosen above.
subtitles.noAudio: Couldn’t get the audio out of the video
subtitles.noPermission: Allow speech recognition in iOS Settings
